title: Decision Outcomes and Effectuation Schedule — Appeals and Grievances
content:
**Appeals and Grievances: decision outcomes and effectuation, tier by tier**

What a reviewer can decide, what a favorable decision does and when, and what else follows from a case being open or decided are set per tier:

- *Outcomes*: the outcomes the tier can reach.
- *Dismissal reasons*: the dismissal reasons the tier can use.
- *Effectuation days*: calendar days after an overturned or partially overturned decision within which it is effectuated.
- *Effectuation action*: what effectuating an overturned decision does in the owning category.
- *Effective date*: the date the effect of a favorable decision runs from.
- *Collection suspended*: whether collection of the disputed beneficiary amount is suspended while the case is open.
- *Past-due payment first*: whether every past-due fee or premium must be paid before a favorable decision is effectuated.
- *Quality referral*: whether the case is also referred to clinical quality management.
- *Next-level rights in letter*: whether the decision letter states the next-level rights and deadline.

| Tier | Outcomes | Dismissal reasons |
|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | upheld; overturned | untimely; not appealable; no standing; no representative appointment |
| Beneficiary Grievance | upheld; overturned | no standing |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | upheld; overturned; partially overturned | untimely; not appealable; no standing; no representative appointment |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | upheld; overturned | untimely; not appealable; no standing; no representative appointment |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | upheld; overturned; partially overturned | untimely; not appealable; no standing; no representative appointment |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | upheld; overturned; partially overturned | untimely; not appealable; no standing; no representative appointment |

| Tier | Effectuation days | Effectuation action | Effective date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | 30 | reprocess the line at the corrected allowed amount | the date of service of the line |
| Beneficiary Grievance | 0 | none | not applicable |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | 30 | reverse and readjudicate the claim line | the date of service of the line |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | 10 | reinstate the enrollment without a gap | the day after the old paid-through date |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 10 | issue the authorization, or reverse and readjudicate the claim line | the first service date under appeal, or the effectuation date |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 1 | issue the authorization | the effectuation date |

| Tier | Collection suspended | Past-due payment first | Quality referral | Next-level rights in letter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | yes | no | no | no |
| Beneficiary Grievance | no | no | yes | no |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | yes | no | no | yes |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | no | yes | no | no |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | yes | no | no | yes |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | yes | no | no | yes |

**Notes**

- A partially overturned outcome exists only on the Claim Factual Reconsideration, the Medical Necessity Reconsideration and the Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration.
- The Beneficiary Grievance effectuates nothing (0 days, no action) and can dismiss only for lack of standing.
- The Enrollment Reinstatement Review is the only tier whose favorable decision waits on payment of past-due amounts.
